added.summary: The design tokens are authored as CSS: packages/design/tokens/*.css, custom properties on :root named by their path (--motion-duration-fast), one file per surface, with a :root[data-scheme=dark] block for what the dark scheme changes. tokens.json is now generated from them (same keys, values and group notes as `_doc`, the notes taken from the comments over each group's tokens; keys sorted; new tokens added) and the package ships both.
